title: The Blackout
answer: B, the sister. She said she watched TV until ten, but the power was out from nine until eleven. The TV couldn't have been on.

beats.line: Mrs. Lane was found dead during a storm. Three people were in the house. One of them is lying.
The storm knocked the power out from nine until eleven.
Suspect A. The neighbour says she was reading by candlelight.
Suspect B. The sister says she watched her favourite TV show until ten.
Suspect C. The nephew says he was asleep since eight.
Remember. The power was out from nine until eleven.
So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
